Read this first

Not production-ready by declaration. The topology is an illustrative target, the MCP reports are dated observations, NATS/Prometheus were not proven provisioned, money EV is not measurable on current fill lineage, and the public/LAN MCP auth postures require remediation. Gate receipts—not checkboxes—change that truth.

How this checklist controls release

Canonical state

The CSV/JSON task definition is immutable scope. Status is an append-only event referencing task, scope, build, config, contract, evidence digest, actor, review and timestamp. A browser selection is only a draft.

Derived readiness

A task is PASS only when every required acceptance criterion and verification has a current receipt. Any changed input digest automatically makes prior evidence STALE. A gate is never manually checked.

Exact scope

Receipts bind environment, venue/account, instruments, horizons, modes, code/build digest, config digest, contract digest, dataset/replay range and fault profile. Passing one scope cannot certify another.

Stop precedence

Kill switch, safety invariant, account ambiguity, stale authority, unknown position, invalid book, missing lineage or unresolved P0/P1 overrides promotion and new exposure. Rollback never fabricates facts.

  1. Ratify ownership, contracts, identities, formulas, boundaries, and security before implementation.
  2. Implement atomic tasks in dependency order; never mark an epic/reference row as implementation proof.
  3. Run the linked verification with deterministic fixtures or a declared live canary scope.
  4. Store immutable evidence and SLSA-style provenance, then obtain the named independent review.
  5. Append the status event. Recompute task and gate state; changed inputs invalidate prior receipts.
  6. Promotion requires signed gate receipt, empty blocker set, tested stop/rollback, and progressive scope approval.

ORIGIN · True range and trailing ATR in ticks		 F02: Run property, mutation and replay tests
Implementation, evidence and stop rule
Instruction
Prove prefix invariance, duplicate idempotency, cold/warm/restart parity, future mutation immunity, correction policy, cross-platform integer equality and state checksum stability. Formula: TR_i=max(H_i−L_i, abs(H_i−C_{i−1}), abs(L_i−C_{i−1})); ATR_N(x)=ceil_div(sum(TR_{x−N}..TR_{x−1}), N). Units/rounding: Integer ticks; ceiling is deterministic; full N bars required.. Availability: ATR at origin x excludes x and every later bar.. Invalid behavior: Any gap or missing prior close makes ATR null until a full clean window exists..
Acceptance evidence
property/mutation/replay receipt with seeds, corpus and hashes. Required boundary set: Flat bars; gap; large jump; N−1 warm-up; one-tick rounding; future mutation.
Rollback / stop
Any divergence blocks G2/G3 and removes treatment authority.

Instruction

Formula: upper_t=max(H_{t−N}..H_{t−1}); lower_t=min(L_{t−N}..L_{t−1}). Units/rounding: Current observation excluded; integer ticks.. Availability: Available with observation t only when the complete prior N window is quality-valid.. Invalid behavior: Gap or incomplete window is null..
Acceptance evidence
property/mutation/replay receipt with seeds, corpus and hashes. Required boundary set: Current-bar exclusion; old extreme expiry; gap; equal extremes; prefix.
Rollback / stop
Any divergence blocks G2/G3 and removes treatment authority.

ORIGIN · Directional structure and protected swing		 F08: Wire output, named abstention and telemetry
Implementation, evidence and stop rule
Instruction
Publish the registered output/lifecycle contract, named null/zero/refusal reasons, dependency quality, funnel counters, latency and provenance without creating money authority. Formula: BULLISH iff H2>H1+tol and L2>L1+tol; BEARISH iff H2<H1−tol and L2<L1−tol; else RANGE. Pending protected pullback promotes only on a later continuation BOS.. Units/rounding: Integer ticks; deterministic origin/confirmation tie order.. Availability: State changes only when required swings and accepted breaks are available.. Invalid behavior: Insufficient pairs stays UNINITIALIZED; no guessed trend..
Acceptance evidence
contract/topic samples, telemetry/alert evidence and no-money permission proof. Required boundary set: Initialization; pending promotion; no candidate; double BOS; CHOCH; mirror; restart.
Rollback / stop
Withdraw dependents and report degraded state.
